title: sideritis clandestina subsp. cyllenea
intro: Sideritis clandestina subsp. cyllenea, commonly known as Cretan mountain tea, is a subspecies of the Sideritis plant family, specifically a type of mountain tea native to the island of Crete. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can contribute to improved immune function, reduced stress, and relief from respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis clandestina subsp. cyllenea include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help in protecting against oxidative stress, inflammation, and microbial infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
